name: model-router
description: Model router widget: routes each Agent call to the model and effort the benchmark measured for that kind of task (auto, ask or off), rate-limit headroom, what the last 30 days consumed, and one key to re-check the routing.

routing.title: Route Agent calls
routing.description: When the main model starts a task a measured family covers: ask you (ask), rewrite to the measured model and effort without asking (auto), or leave calls alone (off).

mainEffort.title: Main-session effort
mainEffort.description: A prompt that reads as a measured family (a fact lookup, a browser flow, a fix with the test runner) can run its requests at the family's measured effort instead of the session's. advise: the pane shows what it would have done and the estimate; auto: it does it, and goes back to the session's effort within the turn after 3 tool errors; off: nothing.

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: The line under the prompt. full: rate-limit windows, routed calls, what a change saved, what the suggestions add up to, what to check. minimal: windows, routed calls, to check. off: none (the pane still has everything).

struggle.title: Struggle threshold (%)
struggle.description: A project's class of Agent calls is flagged as struggling when at least this share of its calls (and twice the rest of this machine) were re-issued, hit 3+ tool errors inside, or failed. Learned from your own transcripts; the suggestion names the project.

contextWarn.title: Context warning (tokens)
contextWarn.description: From this many tokens re-read per turn, a prompt that reads as a different task gets a word: what the session costs per turn against a new window, and an offer to compact down to the new task. The status line shows the context size from here too.

repo.title: model-router checkout
repo.description: A checkout of the model-router repository, if you have one: to run the benchmark or change the code. ~ is your home folder. When nothing is there, the widget reads the clone the plugin install made, so the install alone is enough.

python.title: Python command
python.description: Empty tries python3, then python, then py. Set it when Python lives elsewhere.

refreshMinutes.title: Refresh every (minutes)
refreshMinutes.description: How often the status line re-reads the repo while the session is open. 0 reads once at start.
